thread:
maria: FYI canary for fennel-13b (int4) is flapping on long codegen prompts. seeing OOMs + token-level quality drops. dump attached below.
aj: can you paste the exact error and the config you used? also which machine type?
maria: running on ded-gpu-p4d-96 (rw pool), batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=1024, prefetch=true, kv_cache=on
maria: logs:
```
[2026-02-15T18:23:12Z] ServeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 1.2GB
[2026-02-15T18:23:12Z] RuntimeWarning: kv cache allocation failed, fallback to eviction
[2026-02-15T18:23:12Z] Trace: alloc_frag=0.47, free_frag=0.18, peak_rss=89.3GB
```
devon: hmm alloc_frag almost 50% — looks like fragmentation, possibly due to int4 kernel allocations + continuous batching
kai: also we saw subtle quality regression (truncated completions mid-identifier) when quantizing with the current round-to-nearest scheme. might be loss from layernorm fp16->int4 knobs
aj: quick mitigation options: lower max_new_tokens to 512, set batch_size=2 for canary, disable prefetching, enable kv_trim=aggressive, and enable cuda_mem_compaction on restart
maria: tried max_new_tokens=512 + batch_size=2: OOMs stopped but tail latency increased ~1.8x for heavy prompts. quality improved but still some token-level corruption on code
devon: proposal: add a short-term rollout profile: fennel-13b-int4 { default.max_new_tokens:512, default.batch_size:2, prefetch:false, kv_trim_threshold:0.3, mem_compaction:on }
kai: can we also enable 'slot_reserve' 0.12 for this model? that helped with fragmentation on marmot-11b
aj: yes slot_reserve=0.12 + periodic kv_compact every 15m should help; also we should disable continuous batching for high-long-context routes to avoid cross-request memory churn
maria: there's also a consistent repro prompt that shows identifier corruption. I'll attach eval snippets and ngram diffs to the ticket.
infra-bot: deploy plan created: canary / dedicated-fennel-int4 -> 10% traffic -> monitor OOMs, token-error-rate, avg latency. alert if OOM_rate > 0.5% or token-errors > 0.2%
aj: follow-ups: maria to upload eval diffs; devon to run memory compaction experiment; kai to validate quant rounding patch; I'll schedule a 30m sync if progress stalls.
maria: uploading evals now, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
